adjudication_rationale: Without the withhold the non-owning replica has no local session, so send_via_directory only queues to the old cluster and returns true (agent_registry.cpp:863-866) and GatewayRouteFallback::prepare resolves the same stale row (dispatch_route_fallback.hpp:75-79): the agent is not on that cluster, so delivery fails in both cases and only the label differs. This is what separates it from the original HIGH, where the replica could deliver and the withhold refused a deliverable command. Every withhold at HEAD is a subset of the withholds at 5710c9998f (the candidate join is unchanged and the confirmation is an additional AND). E6 is NOT relied on (nothing enforces the single-replica posture, #6528 unbuilt). The section 7e terminal-failure path was not traced by the adjudicator; the false label is still told to the caller for the window. Would change my mind: any path by which a non-owning replica can deliver to a directly-connected agent whose route row is stale.

adjudicated_by: enterprise-architect (independent adjudication of 2026-11-14 at 078574ab6e; not the change's author and not the reporter; the de-escalation standard of the severity derivation)
adjudication_rationale: The reclaim UPDATE sets only session_id, lease_until and updated_at (gateway_route_store.cpp:608-611); tombstones null cluster_id (lines 268, 399), so the row fails r.cluster_id IS NOT NULL (line 1050). Even if later re-placed, a match needs the candidate to carry the OLD session, but a live newer session's heartbeat overwrites the list row with its own session and advances presence (offline_endpoint_store.cpp:390-393), so a match implies the newer session never heartbeated for 300 s or more: the agent is not live and the label changes no delivery. Weakens if session_timeout is raised toward 300 s; the ADR sentence stays.
